title: HELIX AlumniProfile Resource
description: An outcomes- and career-focused profile of an alumnus. This resource is DISTINCT from the Advancement Constituent resource: Constituent is giving/advancement-focused (donor segment, giving capacity, prospect stage), while AlumniProfile is career/engagement-focused (employer, career progression, mentoring, career services). The two are cross-linked via constituent_ref for the same person and MUST NOT duplicate giving data — refer to the Constituent record for all philanthropy/solicitation attributes. Post-graduation alumni career data is generally NOT a FERPA education record once the person is an alumnus and the data is independently collected.

person_ref.description: HELIX ID of the underlying Person

student_ref.description: HELIX ID of the Student record from their time enrolled

constituent_ref.description: Cross-link to the Advancement Constituent record for the same person (the giving/advancement-side profile). Giving, donor segment, and solicitation data live on Constituent, NOT here.

primary_degree_ref.description: HELIX ID of the primary Degree earned

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource

data_owner.description: Role or person responsible for data quality

classification.description: Data classification tier per HELIX Govern

ferpa_flags.description: FERPA enforcement flags, applied at Bronze->Silver identity resolution and checked by every consumer before disclosure. See govern/ferpa-disclosure-framework.json. For AlumniProfile, is_education_record defaults to false: post-graduation career data collected independently of the education record is generally not a FERPA record. If any field is sourced from the student education record, treat that lineage accordingly.

is_education_record.description: True if this record is a FERPA education record (34 CFR 99.3).

disclosure_basis_required.description: If true, a consumer must assert a valid 34 CFR 99.31 disclosure basis (or hold 99.30 consent) before data is returned.

directory_restricted.description: True when the student has an active directory-information opt-out (from FERPARestriction.restrict_directory). When true, NO directory information may be disclosed under the 99.31(a)(11) directory exception.

restricted_categories.description: Specific directory-information categories the student restricted (99.37). A field in this list must be withheld even if directory_restricted is false.

legitimate_interest_scope.description: Roles/purposes pre-authorized as school officials with legitimate educational interest for this record (drives the 99.31(a)(1) check).

study_disclosure_allowed.description: Whether this record may be released under a 99.31(a)(6) studies agreement (typically de-identified or under a written agreement).
